translation_concerns.concern: The printed exercise is 7 although the card ID ends in t8.

translation_concerns.concern: Anisotropy alone must not prove crystallinity, isotropy must not prove amorphous structure, and crystalline classification alone must not decide blowability. Ordinary granulated sugar excludes specially prepared glassy sugar.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: All approved distinctions among single crystals, grain orientation, amorphous materials, melt-processing conditions, and common samples are translated without new material assumptions.

translation_concerns.concern: The approved fig-77 exterior image is not a lattice or a distance scale. The source-identity label in the manifest must stay Chinese.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Only the current exercise display label becomes Figure 77. The manifest label remains 图 77. The stipulated lattice and formula-unit counting conditions, and the nearest unlike-ion target, are retained. No image was reopened.

translation_concerns.concern: Approved notes contain prior author claims of independent calculations, image reads, and source=reviewed. These are historical statements in the Chinese input, not operations or approval performed by this translation author.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: The notes are translated as inherited provenance, with the task 4 image-read statement explicitly attributed to prior answer work. This report claims only local translation-integrity checks.

translation_concerns.concern: Approved modern explanations correct or complete the book answers: task 6 has order 10^5 rather than printed 10^8, task 8 includes both requested quantities, and task 10 has approximately 0.0332 kg rather than printed 0.33 kg.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Existing modern values and explanations are translated exactly; every original bookRaw remains untouched. No science or source re-review was performed.

translation_concerns.concern: The approved written answer uses L_v=2.26×10^6 J/kg, Q_s=17688 J, and about 2.38 g of remaining ice. The approved choice uses 2.3×10^6 J/kg, Q=17952 J, and 0.0016 kg remaining ice. Both already have the same final temperature/phase conclusion, but their stipulated constants differ.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Each existing view retains its own stated constants, numerical derivations, and conclusion. The difference is surfaced, not reconciled or independently validated in this translation-only task.

translation_concerns.concern: The approved draft seed_sha256 does not match the actual current seed byte hash.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Both actual input hashes and the inherited recorded hash are reported. The draft binding is preserved without silent repair.

translation_concerns.concern: The manifest source PNG hash refers to a source identity; the seed asset hash records the modern generated PNG. They are not treated as interchangeable bindings.
translation_concerns.candidate_handling: Both complete metadata records are retained. No external figure bytes or metadata files were read to verify either recorded hash.

verification_limits.method: Local JSON assembly and scoped assertions only, restricted to the six approved inputs and the owned candidate outputs. Manual translation content and all final files written using apply_patch.
verification_limits.approval_statement: Author integrity checks are not an independent approval or PASS verdict. Candidate is not publishable.
verification_limits.prose_fidelity: Conditions and word-based physical relationships are preserved by author translation judgment; token checks cannot prove semantic equivalence.
verification_limits.source_science_figure_review: Not performed; existing approved claims, corrections, constants, and historical metadata are inherited without reopening sources.
verification_limits.native_contract: Relevant local contract text and implementation were read only. No native pipeline validator or prepare/finalize/render command was run.
verification_limits.forbidden_operations: No images, network, paid calls, native/render/finalize/prepare, broad tests, DB, git, branches, worktrees, chats, or supervisor messages.
